sa_market_summary: The BMW 3 Series (F30 2012-2018, G20 2019+) is the quintessential used premium sedan in South Africa. The F30 generation is the most commonly traded used BMW on platforms like AutoTrader and Cars.co.za. It offers genuine German engineering at a used price point that many South Africans find accessible. However, ownership costs can be significantly higher than Japanese alternatives — servicing, parts, and tyres all command a premium. Buyer must budget properly. Best bought from a BMW dealer with a certified pre-owned warranty.

known_faults.fault: Timing chain and tensioner failure (N20 engine)
known_faults.description: The N20 4-cylinder engine (320i, 328i F30) has a well-documented timing chain tensioner problem. A stretched chain causes rattling on cold start and can ultimately lead to catastrophic engine failure. This is the single biggest mechanical risk on F30 3 Series in SA.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Listen for a cold start rattle that disappears after 10-20 seconds. Request a BMW diagnostic scan. Any history of this fault is a red flag. Budget for preemptive replacement on examples above 80,000km.
known_faults.source: BMW SA dealer technical bulletins, MyBroadband BMW forum, SA BMW specialist workshops

known_faults.description: BMW's electric water pump on N-series engines fails regularly and can cause sudden overheating. Unlike a belt-driven pump, there is no visual warning before failure — the car simply overheats. Engine damage follows rapidly if not caught immediately.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Request water pump replacement history. On any F30 with 60,000km+, budget for water pump replacement as a service item regardless. Check coolant level and condition.
known_faults.source: BMW SA technical service records, BMW specialist workshops nationwide

known_faults.description: The twin-turbocharged N54 and N55 engines are known for high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) failures. Symptoms include rough running, difficulty starting, and engine misfires.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Check for any previous HPFP replacement in service records. Test start reliability. Request a BMW factory scan for fuel rail pressure data.
known_faults.source: BMW SA technical bulletins, N54 enthusiast community, SA BMW specialist workshops

known_faults.description: The valve cover gasket on N-series engines is a known seeping point at higher mileage. Oil mist around the valve cover and a slight burning smell after driving are common symptoms.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Check the top of the engine for oil residue around the valve cover edge. This is a common but manageable repair.
known_faults.source: SA BMW workshop service data, MyBroadband SA BMW thread

known_faults.description: BMW's iridium spark plugs should be replaced every 60,000km but are often neglected. Old plugs cause misfires, rough idle, and reduced performance particularly noticeable on cold mornings.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Request spark plug replacement history. Plugs are a standard service item — their absence in service records suggests cost-cutting maintenance.
known_faults.source: BMW SA dealer service checklist, SA BMW owners reports

known_faults.fault: Sunroof drain blockage causing water ingress
known_faults.description: Blocked sunroof drains cause water to collect under the headliner and leak into the footwells. Can cause mould, electrical faults, and ECU damage if severe.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Check footwells and boot for moisture. Lift rear seat for damp carpet. Check under the headliner at the sunroof edges.
known_faults.estimated_repair_zar: R500 (drain cleaning) to R8,000+ (electrical damage repair)
known_faults.source: BMW SA owner reports, SA auto electricians

what_to_inspect_before_buying: Cold start engine rattle check — timing chain issue on N20 engines is critical
Full BMW factory diagnostic scan — non-negotiable
Request water pump and thermostat replacement history
Check for any overheating history in service records
Inspect all door seals and sunroof drains for water ingress
Test all iDrive functions, heated seats, and electric windows
Verify BMW SA service stamps — essential for warranty claims and resale
Check tyre condition — BMW fitment tyres (Michelin, Bridgestone runflats) cost R3,000-R5,000 each
Confirm the car has not been mapped or modified — increases mechanical risk
owner_sentiment: Mixed. F30 3 Series owners love the driving dynamics and prestige but consistently report higher-than-expected ownership costs. Common complaint: servicing at BMW SA dealers is expensive (R4,000-R8,000 per service). Many move to independent BMW specialists after warranty. The 320d diesel is preferred for long-distance SA driving due to fuel economy.
